children: OriginTrail lists a mainnet release for October 2026 as its next core deployment milestone. The roadmap treats this release as a separate step from the DKG v10.0.25 software update.

The release moves the NeuroSymbolic Marketplace from testnet onto the live protocol, bringing its TRAC settlement function to mainnet. The announcement gives no further details on the scope of the marketplace rollout.
DKG v10.0.25 is live, strengthening the shared-memory foundation for the next core releases.
The roadmap connects infrastructure, AI services and applications. Here is what is completed, and what comes next 👇

title: OriginTrail: NeuroSymbolic Marketplace moves to mainnet - Oct 2026
